prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: country learning postcard for Bahamas
Primary request: A gentle Nassau harbour and coast in the island country of the Bahamas.
Subject: A cheerful waterfront of modest pastel Bahamian buildings, pink, pale yellow and aqua with white trim, shutters and shaded verandas; bright turquoise sea and a few small ordinary boats.
Scene/backdrop: Low green tropical shores and distant low islands, palms, calm clear harbour, blue sky. Keep the geography low and coastal, no tall mountains.
Style/medium: Cheerful detailed children's-book travel illustration, painterly gouache and digital watercolour with visible brush texture, believable waterfront buildings and boats, gentle saturated teal, ochre, green and coral.
Composition/framing: One landscape 3:2 image, intended 1536x1024. Broad peaceful view across the harbour toward the pastel waterfront; central buildings and boats safely inside central 75% of width and height, with generous sky and water for cropping.
Lighting/mood: Warm natural daylight, welcoming and calm.
Constraints: Stylized educational illustration of Nassau coast, no claim of a UNESCO landmark. No text or letters, UI, flags, logos, watermark, postcard frame or stamp. No gigantic monument, fantasy palace, giant cruise ship, pirate ship, unrelated landmark or invented geography.
inspection: Inspected original PNG. Pastel Bahamian waterfront buildings with shutters/verandas, palms, low green shores and turquoise harbour with small boats. No UNESCO-monument claim, tall mountains, giant monument or cruise ship. Style matches reference. Central waterfront survives crop; foreground boat touches left edge. No readable caption/UI/flags/watermark; a tiny dark hull marking on the right boat is visible, not legible or identifiable as a logo. Preserved unchanged for root review.
